unsupported_claims: DeepWalk trains a skip-gram model with hierarchical softmax on windows of node co-occurrence (hierarchical softmax is only partly in evidence; skip-gram/window not explicitly stated)
LINE trains the first-order and second-order objectives separately and concatenates the results
LINE handles weighted edges via edge sampling rather than random walks
DeepWalk is designed for unweighted graphs (only loosely supported by the statement that it ignores edge weights)
rationale: The core claims are supported: DeepWalk treats truncated random walks as sentences, and LINE optimizes first-order proximity plus second-order proximity based on shared neighbors. The extra details on concatenation, edge sampling, and the skip-gram window setup are not in the provided evidence, though they are generally accurate background.
